title: Sesamum indicum cream for medicinal use
intro: Sesamum indicum cream is a topical herbal preparation made from ground sesame seeds, often combined with other natural ingredients like beeswax, oils, or herbal extracts. It is traditionally used in herbalism to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. The cream is valued for its moisturizing properties and may help alleviate conditions such as eczema, psoriasis, and minor burns. In some cultures, it is also applied to relieve joint pain and improve circulation. Its use in herbal medicine highlights the versatility of sesame as a healing plant.
